name: Zephaniah
overview: The Scriptures present Zephaniah as a multifaceted figure connected to the priesthood and prophetic ministry during critical moments in Judah's history. Notably, Zephaniah, identified as the son of Maaseiah the priest, served under King Zedekiah and was sent alongside Pashur to seek Jeremiah's intercession amid Babylonian threats, highlighting his role in spiritual counsel and leadership (Jeremiah 21:1-2). Additionally, Zephaniah is recognized as a prophet during King Josiah's reign, emphasizing his prophetic voice in a time of national reform (Zephaniah 1:1). His lineage also ties him to the priestly Kohathite family, underscoring his heritage and standing within Israel's religious structure (1 Chronicles 6:36).
